title: SPD-Technology: Senior Backend Engineer · Kotlin / Java (Full-time)
description: Senior Backend Engineer on floLIVE — a cloud platform for managing global IoT networks and mobile connectivity, integrating with worldwide mobile operators on a microservices architecture (customer/SIM management, billing, traffic routing, analytics, automation of IoT-device interactions). Most recently owned the architecture of the CMP Aggregator — a multi-tenant SIM/IoT device-management platform that unifies multiple mobile operators behind a single API.

listDescription: Architecture Ownership (CMP Aggregator): Owned key architecture decisions for the integration layer — connector data model, event contracts, local connector-replica model, and vendor-credential security (AES-256-GCM at rest, decrypted only in-memory within the gateway).

Reactive Vendor Gateway: Designed and built a reactive vendor gateway (Kotlin Coroutines, Spring WebFlux, R2DBC) integrating an external vendor API — SIM lifecycle, state transitions, signaling, and reporting — unifying multiple vendors behind a single aggregator contract despite divergent external APIs and semantics.

Event-Driven Processing (Apache Kafka): Built event-driven CUD with staged routing (source-of-truth → local replicas → view services) and aggregator ↔ vendor data synchronization, with idempotency and compensating handling.

Billing, Invoicing & Reporting: Built scalable, fault-tolerant microservices in Kotlin with Spring Boot (WebFlux, Spring Data, Security) for billing, invoicing, and reporting, including dynamic PDF invoice generation via JasperReports.
Provider & Ordering Services: Delivered features across provider and ordering microservices, including a Jira-integrated ordering workflow.
REST API Development: Designed and developed REST APIs, closely collaborating with frontend teams for seamless integration.
Observability: Set up service observability — Spring Boot Admin, Micrometer/Actuator metrics, Grafana dashboards, and Jaeger distributed tracing.
Testing & QA: Created unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, and Testcontainers, ensuring high-quality and reliable code.
CI/CD & Deployment Ownership: Owned CI/CD and deployment — authored Helm charts for Kubernetes and configured Jenkins pipelines (Docker, Gradle).

Delivery Standardization: Standardized delivery across all microservices — built a custom Gradle plugin (service versioning + deployment setup) and shared internal libraries with a centralized dependency catalog, adopted team-wide; led technical demos for client teams.

title: Internship SPD-Technology: Junior Java Developer
description: An internal IoT security platform at SPD Technology, designed to provide real-time insights from IoT devices and enable data visualization for end-users. listDescription: Backend Development:  Contributed to backend architecture and functionality development using Java and Spring Boot, within a 6-member Agile team.

Testing & Quality Assurance:  Developed unit and integration tests to validate functionality, reliability, and overall quality of the solution.
Agile Methodology:  Worked actively using SCRUM methodologies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and iterative improvements.
